decimal.name: supplierOpenQiRate
decimal.title: Open quality improvement rate (%)
decimal.help: 100 when the supplier has no open quality improvement, whatever its creation date, decreasing to 0 when there is at least one open quality improvement per reception of the rolling period.

decimal.name: supplierNonConformityRate
decimal.title: Non-conformity rate (%)
decimal.help: 100 when the supplier caused no non-conformity over the rolling period, decreasing to 0 when the gravity-weighted count of its quality improvements reaches the number of receptions. Every non-cancelled quality improvement carrying the supplier counts, dated by its reception when it has one and by its creation date otherwise; a quality improvement without gravity counts as major.

decimal.name: supplierQualityScore
decimal.title: Quality score
decimal.help: Weighted average of the open quality improvement rate and the non-conformity rate, using their supplier score weights. Compared with the monthly history to determine the quality trend.

integer.name: supplierQualityTrendSelect
integer.title: Quality trend
integer.help: Variation of the quality score against the monthly snapshot taken the configured number of months ago. Empty while the history is too short.
